status: fixed before fitting and held-out evaluation
purpose: CPU-only empirical mechanism pilot on real annotated texts, not full original large-model reproduction
tasks: MATRES temporal relation classification with supplied events and query pairs

acos.split: official train/dev/test; remove training texts duplicated in dev/test; split official dev by stable text hash into calibration and policy halves
acos.span_candidates: all text spans up to 5 tokens, top 4 per role plus semantic implicit value; no test gold insertion
acos.record_candidates: top 2 category/sentiment records for each aspect/opinion candidate pair; categories from training only
acos.scoring: CPU sparse logistic classifiers; calibration only on calibration half of dev
acos.initial_state: raw classifier scores >=0.5, records require selected endpoints
acos.selection: joint repair full-record micro-F1 on policy half of dev; ties prefer fewer edits, then larger kappas
acos.primary_comparison: joint_budget_gates versus sequential using same candidates, scores, kappas and edit caps

matres.split: TimeBank and AQUAINT by document: 80% fit, 10% calibration, 10% validation using stable hash; Platinum 20 documents held out
matres.input: supplied event mentions, attributes, text and annotated-pair query IDs; relation gold excluded from feature and solver inputs
matres.scoring: sparse four-class logistic model, scalar temperature fit on calibration documents
matres.constraints: consistent latent start-point ranks: BEFORE/AFTER strict, EQUAL equality, VAGUE unconstrained; only official main-axis pair labels
matres.initial_legalization: minimum number of changed pair labels, then maximum fixed score; cost reported separately
matres.budget: additional changes from common legal state <= max(1,ceil(0.1*queried_pairs))

statistics: 2000 paired cluster bootstrap resamples; sentences grouped by identical text for ACOS, documents for MATRES; retain all held-out items and all failures
prohibitions: no gold candidate supplementation on held-out input
